entries.evidence: "We treat not only symptoms. We care about each person."
entries.description: "Not only X, but Y" aphoristic construction is a classic AI copywriting trope.
entries.remediation: Replaced with clinical commitment: "Dedicated to advanced microsurgical precision and comprehensive ophthalmic care for every patient."

entries.description: Proportional numerals in animated counter cause horizontal character jitter during count-up.
Animation loop in Counter useEffect does not return a cleanup function to cancelAnimationFrame if unmounted mid-animation.
entries.remediation: Stored requestAnimationFrame handle and added cancelAnimationFrame cleanup in useEffect return.

entries.evidence: icon: Sparkles for Modular Surgical Suite & Advanced Phaco OT
entries.description: Sparkles icon is a generic AI visual trope; inappropriate for clinical ophthalmic operating theatre.
entries.remediation: Replaced Sparkles with Activity from lucide-react.

entries.evidence: 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06 numbered section markers on medical service cards
entries.description: Numbered markers imply a chronological procedure or sequential steps, but these are independent outpatient services.
entries.remediation: Exempted as intentional editorial visual identity matching design reference.

entries.evidence: Floating badge pills • Reliability, • Experience, • Professional with connector lines
entries.description: Floating micro-tags hovering over cutout portraits are a signature landing page trope.
entries.remediation: Exempted as requested brand visual anchors with screen boundary constraints enforced.

entries.evidence: Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube links point to root domain (e.g. href="https://facebook.com")
entries.description: Social media links without specific profile slugs lead to generic root homepages.
entries.remediation: Replaced placeholder generic channels with verified clinic communications: Instagram (@eyecarewith_rs), WhatsApp, Google Maps Clinic Direction, and direct Phone line.

entries.description: Footer legal links point to in-page hash anchors that have no corresponding target IDs.
entries.remediation: Linked OPD Timings directly to #book-appointment consultation section.

entries.description: Blanket transition: all triggers layout/reflow recalculation on all CSS property shifts.

entries.evidence: Unthemed browser surfaces (native scrollbar, default focus outlines)
entries.description: Unthemed browser surfaces lack cohesive branding.
entries.remediation: Added custom webkit-scrollbar styling and accessible focus-visible outlines in globals.css.

entries.description: Purple/violet gradient is a classic AI template tell caught by impeccable detector.
entries.remediation: Replaced with cohesive clinical blue-to-slate gradient (from-blue-600 to-slate-800).

entries.evidence: Doctor navigation arrows and dots updating activeIndex without scrolling cards into view.
entries.description: Interactive carousel controls promised sliding functionality but only altered a subtle border prop.
entries.remediation: Connected navigation arrows and pagination dots to smooth-scroll target doctor cards into view.

entries.evidence: Appointment section reusing the exact doctor cutout and floating badges from AdvantagesSection.
entries.description: Component cloning AI tell copying a visual composition twice down the page.
entries.remediation: Replaced with a dedicated Clinical Consultation Suite assurance stage with consultation photography and evening OPD timing assurances.

entries.evidence: Single-item flashcard FAQ requiring 5 sequential clicks to read answers.
entries.description: High extraneous cognitive load hiding answers behind artificial pagination.
entries.remediation: Converted into an accessible, scan-friendly Framer Motion interactive accordion list.

entries.evidence: Line-bracketed kicker tags (— JYOTI EYE CARE —) above section headings.
entries.description: Eyebrow kickers above headings are prohibited under impeccable craft floor rules.
entries.remediation: Removed decorative line kickers across MissionSection, DoctorsSection, and ClinicalShowcaseSection.

entries.evidence: Unused imports (Bell, User, MapPin), dead SVGs in Footer, and transition-all in HeroSection.
entries.description: AI boilerplate leftovers and non-targeted CSS transitions.
entries.remediation: Removed ghost imports/SVGs, linked footer anchors, and targeted transitions to transform/box-shadow.
